newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Court ignored as Socialists awarded Serbian town.
newsitem.headline: Court ignored as Socialists awarded Serbian town.

text.p: The election commission in the Serbian town of Smederevska Palanka on Wednesday ignored a court order and confirmed the ruling Socialists as winners of local elections in November, an independent radio station reported.

"The town election commission completely ignored the court order and our objections and confirmed the Socialists victory," a leader of the opposition Zajedno (Together) coalition told Belgrade radio B92.
The district court ruled on Monday that Zajedno's victory in the election in the south-eastern town should be restored and ordered the socialist-dominated commission to comply.

The court ruling was initially read as a sign that socialist Serbian President Slobodan Milosevic was beginning to bow to pressure from a month of Zajedno street protests against alleged election fraud.
Zajedno says it won victory in 15 of the biggest Serbian cities, including Belgrade, at November 17 local elections, only to have the triumphs reversed by socialist manipulation.
Milosevic on Tuesday pledged to investigate opposition claims of vote rigging in another move interpreted as an indication he was affected by popular protest and Western displeasure.
